features.name: Generic source interface method bodies and default dispatch
features.scope: Independent method and classifier parameters in ordinary/generic source interface bodies, own receivers, bounded calls and captures; class and named/empty object defaults, overrides, transitive specialization, typed/erased bridges, DefaultImpls signatures and Java/Kotlin consumers. Anonymous defaults dispatch through exported interface types.
restrictions: Independent single reference upper bounds; dependent/recursive/multiple bounds and parameter shadowing retain existing boundaries.
Generic interface vararg bodies, source interface default arguments, generic inline/suspend members, generic companions and nested classifiers retain explicit boundaries.
Parameterized named objects remain unsupported. Anonymous nominal metadata and generic-signature parity are not claimed.

Inherited interface helper generation diagnoses compiled parents lacking compatible DefaultImpls; direct class dispatch to JVM defaults remains supported and verified against no-compatibility providers.
No unchanged app-file, full-app, Android device or performance claim.
